body.name: Candidate calendar diagnostic functional
body.construction:
The candidate diagnostic calendar functional and its minimizing depth are
\[
\rho_{N,T,m}:=\min_{m\le k\le\lfloor\delta T\rfloor}
\left\{L(k/T)^\beta+B\frac{k}{T-k}+\frac{\sigma\sqrt{T/N}}{k}\right\},
\qquad
k^\star\in\operatorname*{argmin}_{m\le k\le\lfloor\delta T\rfloor}
\left\{L(k/T)^\beta+B\frac{k}{T-k}+\frac{\sigma\sqrt{T/N}}{k}\right\}.
\]
